name: Vetster
description: Online veterinary telehealth platform connecting pet parents with licensed veterinarians and vet technicians for on-demand virtual appointments, 24/7, through its website and mobile apps.

evidence.summary: Official Vetster affiliate page fetched: 'No cost to sign up', 'No cap on commission', program managed by Impact Radius (Impact), application usually approved within 1 business day, brand assets and a unique promo code provided. 'Share & earn' section: a fixed commission per appointment booked with the affiliate's promo code, and 'There's no cap on commissions, so share as much as you’d like across as many platforms as possible!' — an explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own page, so the commission cap is recorded as UNCAPPED. The official page does NOT publish the fixed per-appointment amount, so commission_rate is null.

Third-party listings conflict on the flat amount: The Affiliates List reports $15 per order via Impact with a 30-day cookie, while Lasso reports $30.00 per order for Vetster, Inc. Because the official page publishes no amount and third parties conflict ($15 vs $30), the rate is recorded as null rather than guessed.
The same official page publishes the contact email support@vetster.com for affiliate questions ('Questions? Just email us at support@vetster.com').

opportunity.title: Vetster Affiliate Program — fixed commission per appointment via Impact, no cap on commissions (support@vetster.com)

reasons.niche_fit: 24/7 online vet advice is a highly demonstrable, problem-led topic for pet-parent UGC (first vet visit, late-night worries, senior-pet care)
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official page is built for audience owners: it hands creative direction to the affiliate ('the creative direction is all yours'), supplies brand assets and a personal promo code for content
reasons.compensation: Verified UNCAPPED on the brand's own page ('No cap on commission'); the flat per-appointment amount is not published officially and third parties conflict, so compensation is scored below a published-rate uncapped program
reasons.contact_access: Published support email support@vetster.com on the official affiliate page
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Impact, usually approved within 1 business day, no cost to sign up
reasons.credibility: Established telehealth platform operating across many countries with licensed vets; smaller than the big pet retailers, so credibility is mid-range

name: Innovet Pet
description: Pet-health brand selling CBD/hemp pet products, supplements, skin and coat care, shampoos and blind-dog aids through its own store, built around founder pets' stories (Maximus the blind dog, Gordo the bulldog).

evidence.summary: Official Innovet Pet affiliate page fetched: program run on Awin with a dedicated affiliate manager; 'We pay 20-40% starting commission rate per sale. Higher volume affiliates may be eligible for a higher commission rate'; average order value $60 (up to $24 commission at 40%); 30-day cookie; banners and exclusive coupons provided; real-time tracking through Awin. The FAQ restates 'We pay up to 40% starting commission rate per sale on average... Even our lowest starting commission at 20% per sale'. The published rate is a range set by the brand itself, so the starting rate of 20 is recorded. No cap statement appears anywhere on the fetched page, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown.

The same page names ideal partners as bloggers, doggie daycares, dog walkers, dog trainers, veterinarians and animal lovers, accepts affiliates worldwide where Awin operates, charges no fees, and sets a $50 commission threshold before payout.

opportunity.title: Innovet Pet Affiliate Program — 20-40% starting commission via Awin, 30-day cookie, $60 average order

reasons.niche_fit: Pet health and CBD pet care are staple, demonstrable topics for pet UGC, with problem/solution products (mobility, skin, anxiety, blind-dog aids)
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official page explicitly recruits bloggers and pet-content partners and supplies banners, exclusive coupons and a dedicated affiliate manager
reasons.compensation: 20-40% starting commission on the brand's own page — among the highest published pet rates found; higher tiers for volume. No cap statement published, so cap is unknown
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Awin; a dedicated affiliate manager is named on the page but no program email is published, so contact access is scored lower
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via Awin, free to join, affiliates accepted worldwide where Awin operates
reasons.credibility: Long-running specialist pet-health brand with named founder-pet product stories and a large published catalog

name: A1 SolarStore
description: US online retailer of solar panels, solar PV systems, batteries, inverters, HVAC heat pumps and home backup power equipment, selling direct to homeowners with in-house technical expertise.

evidence.summary: Official A1 SolarStore affiliate page fetched: 6% commission on every qualified sale of solar panels, batteries, inverters, HVAC and home backup power; 90-day cookie; weekly Friday payouts with no minimum balance; 95% of transactions approved after verification (up to 7 days). The FAQ answers 'Is there a limit on how much I can earn?' with 'No cap on your total earnings. The only limit is per order: commission maxes out at $250 on a single Catalog Products sale.' — total earnings are explicitly uncapped on the brand's own page, so the cap is recorded as UNCAPPED, with the $250 PER-ORDER ceiling documented here so it is not misread: a single large system sale cannot pay more than $250.

The same page says the program is 'Built for 1,000+ partners' and names creators & influencers (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and niche creators interested in solar, home upgrades and energy savings) as a core partner type, alongside publishers, communities and agencies; every partner gets a personal affiliate manager (contact details in the dashboard after sign-up). The 1,000+ partner figure is a partner count, not a creator count at the ~100 scale, so creator saturation stays unknown.

opportunity.title: A1 SolarStore Affiliate Program — 6% per sale (max $250 per order), no cap on total earnings, 90-day cookie, weekly payouts

reasons.niche_fit: Home solar, batteries and backup power are high-ticket, highly demonstrable home-upgrade topics for home and tech UGC; average purchases run $566-$6,950 on the brand's own table
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official page names YouTube/Instagram/TikTok creators as a core partner type and provides link builder, product feeds, widgets and promo codes
reasons.compensation: 6% per sale with total earnings explicitly uncapped ('No cap on your total earnings'); per-order commission maxes at $250, which the high average order values regularly reach
reasons.contact_access: Direct program (no network layer) with a personal affiliate manager for every partner; manager contact appears in the dashboard after sign-up and a contact form is linked, but no program email is published
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application, Ref ID and dashboard issued immediately at sign-up, review usually within 48 hours, free to join
reasons.credibility: Established US solar retailer with published verification/payout process and a 2025 growth award claim on its own page

name: BestLife4Pets
description: Natural, holistic pet-care brand (BL4P) selling homeopathic-style pet remedies and supplements for dogs and cats through its own store, promoted with personal pet-story and review content.

evidence.summary: Official BestLife4Pets affiliate page fetched: two programs offered. (1) Shopify Collabs (Preferred) — described only as 'high commission rates' with full tracking, unique link and promo codes, contests and giveaways, 30-day attribution, payouts on the 1st of the month; the Collabs percentage itself is NOT published on the page. (2) Amazon Levanta — 20% commission rate, 14-day attribution window on the page (the FAQ separately notes a 24-hour Amazon Associates window). Because the preferred direct program (Shopify Collabs) publishes no rate, commission_rate is recorded as null; the 20% figure belongs to the separate Amazon Levanta channel and is documented here, not recorded as the direct rate. No cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is unknown.

The same page names Theresa, Head of Affiliate Communications, as the support contact at partnerships@bestlife4pets.com, and says content that works best includes personal pet stories/testimonials, product reviews, health tips and pet photos/videos.

opportunity.title: BestLife4Pets Affiliate Programs — Shopify Collabs (preferred, rate on application) or Amazon Levanta at 20% (partnerships@bestlife4pets.com)

reasons.niche_fit: Natural and holistic pet remedies are a strong fit for pet-health UGC built on personal pet stories
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official page explicitly guides creators on content types (stories, reviews, health tips, pet videos) and runs contests and giveaways for affiliates
reasons.compensation: Preferred Shopify Collabs rate is unpublished ('high commission rates' only); the documented 20% belongs to the separate Amazon Levanta channel, so compensation is scored mid-range and the direct rate is null
reasons.contact_access: Named Head of Affiliate Communications with a published partnerships email on the official page
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up to either or both programs, free to join
reasons.credibility: Smaller specialist brand with a named affiliate lead; credibility scored mid-low

name: PupPod
description: Pet-tech brand selling the PupPod Rocker with Feeder — an interactive, app-connected dog toy/feeder that rocks and dispenses treats as a dog plays and learns.

evidence.summary: Official PupPod affiliate page fetched: 'Earn $20 Per PupPod Sold' — a flat $20 for every purchase of a PupPod Rocker with Feeder made through the affiliate's custom link; account creation takes about 30 seconds (name/email/password or Google/Facebook sign-up) via GoAffPro (login at puppod.goaffpro.com); a media kit is provided and the page recommends sharing a picture or video of your own dog playing PupPod. The commission is a flat dollar amount, not a percentage, so commission_rate is null and the $20 flat rate is recorded here and in the opportunity title. No cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is unknown.
The same page directs affiliates to share their link on social media, newsletters, text, email or a website, and to use the Marketing Tools tab to deep-link the product listing.

opportunity.title: PupPod Affiliate Program — flat $20 per PupPod Rocker with Feeder sold, via GoAffPro

reasons.niche_fit: An interactive dog toy/feeder is one of the most filmable pet-tech products — dogs playing on camera is native UGC
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official page recommends affiliates post photos/videos of their own dog playing PupPod and supplies a media kit
reasons.compensation: Flat $20 per unit sold — simple and predictable, but a single-product flat rate rather than a percentage of a basket; no cap statement published
reasons.contact_access: Self-serve GoAffPro sign-up and login; no program email is published on the fetched page, so contact access is scored lower
reasons.opportunity_availability: Instant account creation (about 30 seconds), open to anyone
reasons.credibility: Single-product pet-tech brand with its own store, media kit and published affiliate terms

name: AOSU

evidence.summary: FlexOffers network listing for 'aosu Life' fetched: payout 6.40% per sale, program described by the network as 'a smart home security brand offering easy-to-use solutions for families, including security cameras, video doorbells, solar-powered camera systems, and related home protection products', and 'ideal for partners in smart home, tech, family safety, home improvement, and consumer electronics'.

Lasso's home-security roundup reports AOSU US at up to 15.75% per sale and elsewhere in the same article cites product commission rates of up to 25%. Published rates therefore conflict across sources (6.40% FlexOffers vs up to 15.75% vs up to 25%), so commission_rate is recorded as null with the conflict documented here. No fetched source carries a cap statement, so the cap is unknown.

Sovrn Commerce's merchant page confirms AOSU is a consumer smart-home security brand focused on connected cameras and video doorbells for residential use and lists it for affiliate access through Sovrn, while noting the current rate through Sovrn could not be independently verified.

opportunity.title: AOSU Affiliate Program — smart home security cameras and doorbells via FlexOffers / Sovrn (rate varies by network, see evidence)

reasons.niche_fit: DIY home security cameras and doorbells are a top demonstrable smart-home category for tech and home UGC (installation, night vision, app alerts)
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand works through creator/publisher networks (FlexOffers, Sovrn) aimed at smart-home, tech and family-safety partners, with subscription-free local recording as a review hook
reasons.compensation: Rates conflict across networks (6.40% to up to 25% in published listings), so the rate is null and compensation is scored on the mid-range of what is published; no cap statement found
reasons.contact_access: Network-mediated access only (FlexOffers/Sovrn); no program email published on the fetched sources, so contact access is scored lower
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network application through FlexOffers or Sovrn Commerce
reasons.credibility: Fast-growing security brand with tier-one media and CES/IFA presence reported by Lasso; established Amazon performance

name: Eight Sleep
description: Sleep-technology brand selling the Pod — a smart mattress cover/system that actively heats and cools the bed and tracks sleep — at premium price points (Pods above $1,500-$2,000).

evidence.summary: Eight Sleep's official referral terms page fetched: it distinguishes the individual referral program from the affiliate program and directs businesses interested in the Affiliate program to contact bizdev@eightsleep.com. The same page documents the referral program's own caps (rewards in $100 increments, maximum 100 Qualified Referrals per calendar year) — those caps belong to the customer referral program, NOT the affiliate program, and are documented here so they are not misread as an affiliate cap; no affiliate cap statement was found, so the affiliate cap is unknown.

Published affiliate rates for Eight Sleep conflict across sources: CompareEPC lists the program on Impact at 2%; other roundups report 3% CPS, up to 5%, ~6% with a ~90-day cookie, and up to 10%. Because no official affiliate page publishing a rate was fetched and third parties conflict, commission_rate is recorded as null with the conflict documented here.
